<translate>
'''Ki Infusion''' infuses your fists and weapons with ki. While it is switched on, every melee hit deals bonus damage based on your maximum Ki and spends part of your Ki to do it, which makes it a strong choice for characters with a large Ki pool.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it ==

[[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]] (Good alignment), [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha|Yamcha]] (no alignment requirement) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] (Evil alignment) teach Ki Infusion.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works ==

Switch Ki Infusion on in the Utility Menu ({{Key|X}}) under '''Actions → Ki Actions'''. While it is on:

* every melee hit deals bonus damage equal to '''2.5% of your max Ki per level''' (up to +25% at level 10);
* every hit costs '''2.5% of your max Ki at level 1''', rising to '''7.5% at level 10''';
* the bonus only triggers if you have enough Ki to pay for it.
</translate>

<translate>
These percentages are the server defaults.
</translate>
{{Config|Combat Config|kiInfusion*}}

<translate>
== Notes ==

* Ki Infusion pairs naturally with [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Protection|Ki Protection]], which spends Ki on defense instead of offense; both are toggled from the same menu.
* For damage that scales with Ki Damage instead of max Ki, see the ki weapons of [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Manipulation|Ki Manipulation]].
</translate>
